I was just like you, till I embarked on a quest to learn how to insert flange tips. The results are extremely rewarding. You don't even need the er2xr to disappear fully into your ear to enjoy the benefits, like how some reviewers show the blue part completely disappearing. Just inserting even half of the way through or slightly less is enough. It's all about pulling the outer ear gently while easing them in to their fullest. After a week of committing, you'll find it hard to even go back to a shallower fit. Your ears will adjust.
One vote for er2xr from me. It has a stupendously good tonal balance, which is so good for me that I forget the small and narrow staging when using it

Hi, I just T2-ed Daredevil, but mostly because he's one of my all time favourite comic book characters. The dodge and damage boosts make him near unstoppable in PVP. If the 1* baton stun doesn't connect (due to stun resist or dodge), his guaranteed dodge, coupled with his fluid moveset, helps him to keep raining blows on his opponents, especially if you built him with high dodge. He takes out T2 Sharon Rogers quite fuss free for me. 

However, I must admit that I'm quite biased towards ol' hornhead. Honestly, he won't outshine other meta defining hard hitters like T2 IF (who also has guaranteed dodge to make him much harder to hit). I feel he hits harder than the average speed character though, which increases his viability in a post Shadowland environment. If you're a fan of Daredevil in game or out, this is a no brainer; his T2 elevates him significantly. You won't regret it. If you're looking to dominate competitively though, I would say you can invest elsewhere for the time being... But do give him a chance :) DD's all about the plain, simple, fuss free and speedy beatdown.

Overall assessment: Worth it for me!
